_help: ONE place for every book. Edit here, then run: python3 _src/build.py. Fields: id, series (zero|pflege), position, status (released|upcoming|preorder), released (YYYY-MM-DD, optional), new_until (YYYY-MM-DD, optional: shows a 'New' tag until this date), title, subtitle, short, level, level_name, colour (gold|teal|coral), cover, page, kindle, paperback, pages (optional), print (optional note), blurb (card text), description (page/SEO text), units (optional list).

zero.name: Deutsch: German from Zero
zero.description: A four-book self-study German course for English speakers, from A1 (complete beginner) to B2 (upper intermediate).

pflege.name: German for Nurses & Caregivers (Deutsch Pflege)
pflege.description: Three-book German course for nurses and caregivers in Germany: B1 ward communication, B2 documentation and difficult conversations, and an Exam Trainer.

books.title: Deutsch A1: German from Zero
books.subtitle: A Complete Self-Study Course
books.blurb: No German at all? Greetings, numbers, family, time, shopping, the doctor.
books.description: Start German from zero: greetings, numbers, family, time, daily routine, shopping, food, the city and the doctor — explained in plain English.

books.title: Deutsch A2: German from Zero
books.subtitle: A Complete Self-Study Course with Exercises, Mock Exam & Answer Key
books.blurb: The past, your home, health, work and plans — and the A2 exam.
books.description: Talk about what you did, where you live, your health, work and plans — and get ready for an A2 exam.

books.title: Deutsch B1: German from Zero
books.subtitle: A Complete Self-Study Course with Exercises, Mock Exam & Answer Key
books.blurb: Opinions, experiences, formal e-mails and B1 exam training.
books.description: Move beyond everyday German: speak, argue and write with confidence at B1.

books.title: Deutsch B2: German from Zero
books.subtitle: A Complete Self-Study Course with Exercises, Mock Exam & Answer Key
books.blurb: German for university, work and real debate — and the B2 exam.
books.description: Reach B2: argue, report and write at university and workplace level, with over 600 new words and example sentences.

books.title: Deutsch B1 Pflege: Ward Communication & Patient Care
books.subtitle: German for Nurses & Caregivers · Band 1
books.blurb: Body, pain, vital signs, morning care, handover, falls, relatives.
books.description: Talk with residents and patients, work in a German team and start preparing for your nursing German exam.
books.for: Nurses and caregivers with general German of about A2–B1 who are new to the ward.

books.title: Deutsch B2 Pflege: Documentation & Difficult Conversations
books.subtitle: German for Nurses & Caregivers · Band 2
books.blurb: SIS, Pflegebericht, ISBAR calls, dementia, palliative care, rights.
books.description: The level usually required for professional recognition: write clear, objective care documentation, call a doctor with ISBAR, and handle relatives, dementia and end-of-life care.
books.for: Nurses with B1 general German who need B2 for professional recognition (Anerkennung).

books.title: Deutsch Exam Trainer: Practice Tests for Nursing German Exams
books.subtitle: German for Nurses & Caregivers · Band 3
books.blurb: Complete practice tests, strategies and model answers.
books.description: For when your exam date is close: complete practice tests in the style of the main nursing German exams, FSP-style simulations, time plans, strategies and model answers.
books.for: Nurses and caregivers whose nursing German exam date is close.
